title: Telecom account takeover
summary: A message or caller tries to move your phone service or obtain a verification code.
scenario: Loss of service or an urgent SIM-related request may precede account access attempts.
warning_signs: Requests for a code or identity details
Instructions supplied by an incoming caller
safe_actions: Do not share codes or approve an unexpected change
Contact the telecom provider through a known route
Secure important accounts that rely on the number
recovery_guidance: Ask the provider to secure the line and explain available recovery steps
Change affected account credentials and review sessions
reporting_guidance: Keep notices, caller details, and time of service changes
Use checked provider and reporting routes
prevention_tips: Use additional account protection where available
Keep recovery methods current and private
false_positive_notes: Service interruptions have benign causes, but an unexpected identity request should still be verified.
